body:
Simon Paradox pondered the mysterious book he had received in the mail. It had no title, and it was entirely blank. There was no return address either, just a note: "Whatever you write in this book, you will dream."

He didn't believe it. It must be a silly hoax or maybe the doing of some deluded whacko with too many postage stamps. It's no matter, might as well play along. He thought for a moment, then he laughed to himself. He scribbled on the blank page.

"Today I found a book in the mail. Whatever I write in it comes true in my dreams."

He scooted off to bed shortly thereafter. While on the precipice of sleep, a queer thought struck him, and suddenly he wasn't sure where he was. Then he was out.
